purpose: Teach: 市中/汝/減退/ゴシップ/小声/快挙/真田/悪戯

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、市中、つまり市中感染の動向を医療チームで監視します
lines.en: Ren, we monitor trends in community-acquired infections — the ones spreading out in town — as a team.
lines.style: Calm clinical baseline, unhurried, the practiced clarity of explaining rounds to a student.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医師の心に「汝、患者を救え」を医療チームで持ちます
lines.en: As doctors, we carry the words 'thou shalt save thy patient' in our hearts — the whole team does.
lines.style: A shade quieter and more personal, gentle gravity on the old words, conviction without drama.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者様の認知機能減退を医療チームで丁寧に評価します
lines.en: When a patient's cognitive function is declining, we evaluate it carefully, together.
lines.style: Slower, deliberate care on 'declining,' the softened tone reserved for hard subjects.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者様のゴシップに惑わされない様、医療チームで配慮します
lines.en: And we take care not to let gossip about a patient sway anyone on the team.
lines.style: Slightly firmer, a dry edge of warning, brisk professional cadence.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、診察時に小声で話される患者様にも医療チームで丁寧に対応します
lines.en: If a patient can only speak in a whisper during the exam, we take the time to listen properly.
lines.style: Voice softening to demonstrate, patient tempo, warmth folded into the professionalism.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、難手術の快挙、つまり成功を医療チームで共有します
lines.en: When a difficult surgery succeeds — a real triumph — we share that moment as a team.
lines.style: A rare brightening, quiet satisfaction lifting the middle of the line, restrained smile.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者真田様のご症状を医療チームで継続観察します
lines.en: Mr. Sanada's symptoms — we'll keep him under continuous observation, all of us.
lines.style: Back to steady clinical focus, precise on the name, calm forward-looking assurance.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療機器のいたずら、つまり悪戯設定を医療チームで防ぎます
lines.en: And we guard against any tampering with the equipment — mischief with the settings included.
lines.style: Wry, matter-of-fact close, faint amusement on 'mischief,' then a settled final cadence.
